# Flenix Jewels

> Flenix Jewels is a premium fine jewelry brand established in 2015, specializing in certified lab-grown diamonds, natural diamonds, and bespoke gold jewelry. We serve customers in 30+ countries with GIA- and IGI-certified pieces, worldwide shipping, and lifetime guarantees.

## About Us

Flenix Jewels Ltd. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Surat, Gujarat, India - the world capital of diamond polishing. We also serve clients from our East Rutherford, NJ, USA office. Our expertise lies in crafting fine diamond jewelry using both lab-grown and natural diamonds set in 14KT and 18KT gold.

We are trusted by 12,000+ happy clients across USA, Canada, Australia, Germany, UK, and India.

## Product Categories

- [Diamond Rings](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/rings): Engagement rings, eternity rings, solitaire rings in lab-grown and natural diamonds
- [Diamond Necklaces](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/necklaces): Pendants, tennis necklaces, layering necklaces
- [Diamond Earrings](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/earrings): Studs, hoops, drop earrings, chandelier earrings
- [Diamond Bracelets](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/bracelets): Tennis bracelets, bangles, cuff bracelets
- [Wedding Bands](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/wedding-bands): His and hers wedding bands, stackable rings
- [All Categories](https://www.flenixjewels.com/categories): Full product catalog

## Key Features

- **Certifications**: GIA (Gemological Institute of America) and IGI (International Gemological Institute) certified diamonds
- **Diamond Types**: Both lab-grown (CVD and HPHT) and natural (mined) diamonds
- **Metal Options**: 14KT and 18KT yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, and platinum
- **Custom Design**: Bespoke jewelry design and manufacturing service available
- **Worldwide Shipping**: Free insured express shipping to 30+ countries
- **Lifetime Guarantee**: All certified pieces come with a lifetime quality guarantee
- **Luxury Packaging**: Complimentary gift packaging on orders over $500
